key.name: app-grid-enabled
key.summary: Whether ChairLift sets the Show Applications mark

key.name: app-grid-slug
key.summary: Simple Icons brand name for the app grid
key.description: A simpleicons.org slug, or 'custom' to use app-grid-custom-path. Empty means no mark has been chosen.

key.name: app-grid-custom-path
key.summary: Path to the user's own SVG for the app grid

key.name: panel-enabled
key.summary: Whether ChairLift sets the panel mark

key.name: panel-foundation
key.summary: Selected foundation for the GNOME panel
key.description: A foundation id from internal/livery's catalog, or 'custom' to use panel-custom-path. An unset or unknown value resolves to this machine's default, which is the Open Gaming Collective on a gaming image and CNCF elsewhere.

key.name: panel-custom-path
key.summary: Path to the user's own SVG for the panel

key.name: panel-rotate
key.summary: Advance the panel mark at each login

key.name: saved-panel-icon
key.summary: Extension icon value to restore on revert

key.name: saved-panel-mode
key.summary: Extension display-mode value to restore on revert

key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Whether ChairLift sets the Files application mark

key.name: dock-foundation
key.summary: Selected CNCF project for the Files application
key.description: A project directory name from cncf/artwork, or 'custom' to use dock-custom-path. The project's own color icon is fetched on demand.

key.name: dock-custom-path
key.summary: Path to the user's own SVG for the dock

key.name: dock-rotate
key.summary: Advance the Files mark at each login

key.name: last-rotation-token
key.description: Idempotence key: a rotation pass whose token matches this value does nothing, so re-running it cannot double-advance the selection.
